speaker: client
text:
The site looks great and seems nearly ready to go live. Aside from a few tweaks like text, which I can come up with, it appears close to completion.

Would it be possible to create a couple of places across the home page and gallery that link to video? Ideally, videos would be integrated with the portfolio as well. Is that something we could do?

speaker: agency
text:
It’s great to hear that you’re happy with how the site is coming together.

Video integration on both the homepage and gallery is possible, and we can make the videos blend seamlessly with the rest of the portfolio. On the Home page, they can be placed in any section you choose. For the Gallery page, we still need to evaluate whether the videos should have a separate tab or appear alongside the pictures.

Please let us know which presentation you prefer.

Thank you!

speaker: client
text: For the gallery, integrating the videos alongside the pictures would be ideal. On the home screen, the video would work best beside the portfolio photos. Thanks!
